content: Hi! Tell me about the analysis you're planning — what kind of data, what question, what you've already done. I'll work through it with you and pull together the package when we're ready.

I have a bulk RNA-seq dataset from Himes et al. (airway, GSE52778): 4 human airway smooth-muscle cell lines, each with dexamethasone-treated vs untreated samples (8 samples total). I have registered the gene-level count matrix and sample metadata under the input label himes-inputs. Please run a standard bulk RNA-seq differential expression analysis of the dexamethasone treatment effect, controlling for cell line (design ~ cell + dex), followed by pathway enrichment and a final report.
The plan's on the confirmation card now — take a look and click Confirm if it looks right, or let me know what to adjust.

args.summary_markdown:
## Airway dex DE analysis (GSE52778, Himes et al.)

DE results are statistical associations for the dex-vs-untreated contrast, not causal or mechanistic claims. Effect sizes reported with adjusted p-values.

- Input: gene-count matrix + metadata (himes-inputs), 8 samples, 4 cell lines
- Starting point: counts-first (no trimming/alignment/quantification re-run)
- Design: ~ cell + dex, testing the dexamethasone effect
- Normalization + DE testing on the count matrix
- Pathway enrichment on the ranked DE result
- Final report summarizing findings + literature context

Confirm to lock in or correct any.
